slides.title: The same block again?
slides.text: Bolt has to go 5 squares in a straight line. You could use move, move, move, move, move. That is a lot of the same block!
slides.alt: Five separate move blocks stacked in the tray do the same job as one repeat block, but take five times the room.

focus.cue: Five move blocks, all the same.
They walk Bolt five squares to the flag.

slides.title: Meet the loop
slides.text: A loop repeats steps so you do not have to write them again. In Robo Route the loop block is called repeat.
slides.alt: One bracket does the work: a repeat 5 times block with a single move block inside it, and Bolt's row of five squares ahead.

focus.cue: Meet the repeat: it runs its inside again and again.
The move sits inside, so the move is what repeats.

slides.title: Five blocks become two
slides.text: Put one move inside a repeat set to 5. Bolt goes 5 squares, and you only used two blocks.
slides.alt: One bracket does the work: a repeat 5 times block with a single move block inside it, and Bolt's row of five squares ahead.

focus.cue: Two blocks do the whole job: repeat 5, with move inside.

slides.title: What the number means
slides.text: The number says how many times the whole loop runs. A repeat 3 with move, move inside makes 6 moves, not 3.
slides.alt: A repeat 3 times bracket holds two move blocks, so Bolt drives six squares in all: the number times the blocks inside.

focus.cue: Repeat 3 times: the whole loop runs three times.
Two moves inside, so 3 × 2 = 6 moves in all.

slides.title: Inside or outside?
slides.text: Only the blocks inside the repeat get repeated. If the turn is inside instead of the move, Bolt just spins in place!
slides.alt: The repeat bracket holds turn right instead of move, so Bolt would spin on one square instead of driving anywhere.

focus.cue: The block inside the repeat is turn right — not move.
So Bolt would spin on this one square, five times.

words.means: steps that run again and again
the Robo Route block that makes a loop
the number on the loop: how often it runs
steps that happen the same way again

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Robo Route at Loops and finish all 7 levels. First look for the pattern: which blocks happen again and again? Put those inside a repeat.
slides.alt: One bracket does the work: a repeat 5 times block with a single move block inside it, and Bolt's row of five squares ahead.

focus.cue: Your turn: find the pattern, then put it inside a repeat.
